title: SeqSol deep learning prioritizes solubility-enhancing mutations in two enzymes
summary: In wet-lab tests, 30 mutations raised the solubility of two enzymes from 56.18% and 10.53% to over 95% with activity maintained; SeqSol had AUC 0.840 on an independent test. Only two enzymes were tested.
ai_technology: SeqSol deep learning model with structural modelling for single-mutation prioritization
organization: Zhejiang University of Technology, Hangzhou, China

evidence.tested: Independent test AUC 0.840; wet-lab mutant testing
evidence.unknown: Two enzymes only; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: SeqSol deep learning prioritises solubility-enhancing single mutations
